topic: Promo carousel for the live video "AI Is Wiping Out All These Jobs"
body_style: watch-the-full-video link + headline + two arrow points + hashtags
body:
▶ Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/qNufKTtCF_Q

AI is already taking jobs that felt safe just two years ago.

→ Employers named AI as a reason for 121,401 job cuts in 2026
→ 70% say AI will cut jobs, but only 30% of workers worry about theirs

#AI #FutureOfWork #Jobs

images.slide_text: AI's taking jobs that felt safe
They've been searching for months / Some of the people in the video say AI took their work. And the next jobs in line are the ones you were told a machine could never do.
Employers named AI as a reason / 121,401 / Since 2023 the total is 193,226. October was the lowest month of the year, only 1,265.
The quiet part / Entry-level postings down 7.5% in a year, senior up 14.7%: still hiring, just not beginners.
The jobs just stopped showing up / 30% / From over 3 million freelance job posts, the first year after ChatGPT. Total freelance demand still went up.
Jobs nobody believes are at risk
Feeling safe isn't being safe / One poll in March 2026: most expect AI to cut jobs, only 30% of workers worry about their own.
Watch the full video / AI Is Wiping Out All These Jobs
